subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Does PR #102160 provide enough current-main proof to close #84569 despite the remaining WhatsApp `isError` suppression gates, or should the issue stay open until WhatsApp final fallback delivery is fixed/proven?
rationale: A merged maintainer-side comment says both roots are fixed at the run/dispatch layer, but source inspection still shows the adapter suppressing the exact final-error payload class previously identified as a root cause.

options.title: Keep Open For WhatsApp Delivery Proof
options.body: Leave #84569 open until a build with PR #102160 shows redacted WhatsApp fallback delivery proof or the adapter suppression gates are changed.

options.title: Close As Run-Lifecycle Fixed
options.body: Close only if maintainers confirm the new terminal-error path cannot reach the remaining WhatsApp `isError` suppression branches for this issue's failure mode.

options.title: Move Remaining Delivery Work To #87561
options.body: Close this issue only after explicitly documenting that #87561 owns the remaining WhatsApp final-fallback delivery contract and this concrete report needs no separate tracking.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For WhatsApp Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Leave #84569 open until a build with PR #102160 shows redacted WhatsApp fallback delivery proof or the adapter suppression gates are changed.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz owns the assigned issue context and the broader final-fallback contract that should decide whether the WhatsApp proving case is still required.
